summary: Evidence-bounded static site redesign for Sarnelli Arquitetura. Built index.html (production homepage with pillar→proof→process→contact sequence), proposal.html (independent sales document), rationale.html (redirects to proposal), styles.css (OKLCH palette with Montserrat/Roboto typography, responsive breakpoints), script.js (mobile nav toggle, smooth scroll, inert demo form), README.md, SITE_REVIEW.md, SOURCE_MANIFEST.md. All business facts sourced from prospect.json, PRODUCT.md, and BRAND_SOURCE.md only. Removed all placeholder content, Lorem Ipsum, unsupported awards, and repeated project labels from the original site. Portfolio organized by tipologia (hospitais, clínicas, escolas, institucional) with only published project names (Erastinho, Santa Casa, Centro Médico Erasto). Contact section offers phone/WhatsApp visible at journey end. No proposal/redesign language in index.html. deliverable_tier: production_complete.
